title: SourceStateRef
description: A reference to the temporally controlled state that OWNS an evidence unit. It is normally RETURNED by a grounding profile (via owner resolution) and need not be persisted in the TIER-Graph database. The profile is authoritative for the temporal admissibility of the source state. `sourceStateId` identifies a source state (e.g. a document version) and the optional `sourceObjectId` the canonical source object it belongs to (e.g. the work/record it is a version of). The TIER-Graph core MUST NOT copy the source state's temporal interval onto a DerivedRelation.

profileId.description: Identifier of the TemporalGroundingProfile that controls this source state.

sourceStateId.description: Opaque identifier of the source state within the profile's substrate.

sourceObjectId.description: Optional identifier of the canonical source object the state belongs to (e.g. the item/work whose version this is).

metadata.description: Profile-specific properties. MUST NOT be relied upon by the core for temporal logic.
